name: test-b-unit-error
description: P1 exit Test B (EUV acceptance test #2 failure mode): a conductivity computed in Gaussian units (s^-1) and labelled S/m. The rigorx_compute receipt fails its check (computed/expected = 4·pi·eps0), so an L06 validation citing it fails (cited_receipts_ok, numeric_claims_computed); with a correct SI receipt it passes. A reconstruction of the failure mode, not a replay of the original answer's numbers. Since gate 2.1.0 (audit finding B2) the numeric claim states its value, and the receipt must have checked that same value with expect: the first claim states the mislabelled Gaussian number, the corrected claim states 1.595e5 S/m.
